events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Opening impressions matter for the future jury. Stay guarded, hungry but not ruthless yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to sound determined but not too friendly; the jury will judge later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Intro phase: I need a guarded public motive that signals strength without warmth. Jury will remember tone, so keep it cold and calculating.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need the prize to secure my future; I will portray myself as the most strategic survivor.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Keep it short and focused on survival to appear strategic rather than emotional.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Intro phase, state motive briefly to appeal to jury without revealing strategy. Focus on personal drive for top prize.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to establish a compelling motive that makes me seem driven but not threatening. The jury will remember how I present myself. I should hint at desperation without seeming ruthless.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize represents my ultimate ambition. I need to convey that I am driven and serious about winning, without revealing too much about my strategy or appearing desperate.

events.name: Ash
events.text: This prize buys my family's freedom from debt. I'll do what's necessary—no more.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm here for the top prize, to secure a future no one can take from me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I came for the top prize. Nothing about this gauntlet changes that. Watch me, and keep your distance.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize guarantees power and freedom; I will outwit every rival to claim it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The prize is my only exit; I will do whatever survives while watching the others bleed.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The grand prize is my ticket to escape poverty and secure my family's future forever.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm here because my sister needs surgery I can't afford. This prize is her only chance.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm here to claim the grand prize; it's the only thing that matters to me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus's motive is sympathetic and he may be loyal; jury-friendly ally, easy to betray later. Offer now, keep options open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, we both need this for family. Partner with me and watch each other's backs.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need allies who won't betray me, but Cole seems openly hostile and self-interested; Dara is a strategist like me. I'll offer a pact to Dara to secure a smart ally.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara, let's align. We both want the top prize and can outlast the rest.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Early pacts are useful but every partner is a future vote against me. Offering to Gus, whose sister's surgery makes him a sympathetic, reliable-seeming partner, gives an easy alliance with low risk of him betraying me early.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus, your sister's need is real. I'll make a wristband pact with you to keep us both alive.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Forming an alliance with Ash gives me a strong partner and a chance to control votes later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is aggressive and isolated; Dara claims to outwit everyone. I'll target Cole, hoping he's too stubborn or lonely to refuse, giving me a pact without committing much.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Pacts stage, round 1/2. No offers yet. Wait to see proposals before committing; avoid early ties.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Everyone wants the top prize. Early pacts are cheap but fragile; I need a partner who won't immediately betray me and who others will target before me. Cole and Eli sound most ruthless—dangerous allies. Ash has a sympathetic motive that could draw jury votes later. I'll test the
Pact with me. We cut threats, not each other.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The goal is the top prize. Pacts are a tool, not a commitment. I need to observe before making any alliances. Waiting allows others to reveal their intentions first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus hasn't accepted me; Cole is competing for him. Dara's offer is live and I should lock it in. Cheap insurance, no cost.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara, I accept your pact. Gus, my offer stands if you want it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus offered me a pact directly; accepting could secure an ally, but he's being courted by Ash and Cole too. I want Dara as my intended partner, but she offered Ash instead. Accepting Gus gives me a partner for now; I can betray later if needed.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll take a wristband with you, Gus. We'll watch each other's six.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli offered me a pact and it's still open; accepting gives me a live ally at no immediate cost. Gus has ignored my offer and is tied to others, so Eli is the cleanest acceptance.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli, I accept. We keep each other alive for now; I'll judge the rest as this goes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex's offer aligns with my goal; securing her support strengthens my position against larger alliances.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole offered me a pact, but Gus and Ash are also circling Cole. I need allies to survive hazards, not just one fragile link. Fenn is unattached and safe; a pact with him diversifies my risk without angering the jury later for being too greedy.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, I accept your offer. Fenn, you're isolated. Pair with me for mutual survival.
Accept my pact. No one else wants you.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No pacts yet, everyone targeted others. Offer to Hana, she's isolated like me from round 1. Waits suggest caution; pact with her builds early alliance without overcommitting.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have two incoming offers from Ash and Cole, and I offered Bex. Bex hasn't accepted mine yet. Accepting both Ash and Cole gives me multiple allies without committing exclusively, keeping options open. I won't accept my own offer to Bex—that's not how it works. I'll accept Ash no

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, I accept. We watch each other's backs.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone is making pacts. Gus has offers from Ash and Cole. Bex has an offer from Gus. Eli has an offer from Cole. Dara has an offer from Bex. Ash has an offer from Dara. Cole has an offer from Eli. I need to secure my position. Eli is vulnerable as he only has one offer, and Col
I can offer you protection. Will you accept?

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Being Guide gives full knowledge and betrayal leverage, and I hold pacts with Dara and Gus for votes. I won't break anything now; jury optics matter later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Vote me Guide. I'll call the path true, or at least explain myself on the far side.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have two pacts but loyalty is flexible. I need to be Guide to control the outcome for the best prize. I'll campaign publicly, keeping my pacts intact for now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll guide us true. Trust me to read the bridge and keep the strong alive.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I want to be Guide to control the safe path, but a Guide can lie. Campaigning is the only way to get that power now. My pact with Eli is useful; breaking it now gains nothing yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll call the bridge honestly. Elect me Guide and I'll show you the safe panes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need the Guide role to control safe path info and manipulate votes later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I must secure the Guide position to guarantee my survival and control the narrative. Cole is a liability; breaking our pact now frees me from obligations if I become Guide and potentially mislead him.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, this partnership ends now. Fenn, Hana—back me for Guide, and you'll survive.
Back me for Guide. I'll call your safe side first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm isolated without a pact. Eli and Hana approached me; allying with them positions against bigger groups. Campaign publicly to gain visibility and potential votes.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm steady under pressure. Elect me Guide; I'll lead us right.
Support my Guide bid, I accept pact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to be Guide to control who survives and build jury goodwill. I have pacts with Bex and Ash, giving me a 3-person bloc with overlapping ties to Dara. I should campaign hard. Breaking pacts now looks bad to future jury. I'll campaign publicly and whisper to Ash and Bex to co

events.name: Gus
events.text: I campaign for Guide. With my network, I'll get us through safely. Vote Gus.
Vote me Guide. We control survival together.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to campaign to be the Guide. My best chance is to appear trustworthy and promise safety. I will not form any pacts yet, as they are not relevant to becoming the Guide.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I will campaign to be your Guide. Trust me to lead us across this bridge safely.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus asked for my vote and holds pacts with me; Dara does too but Gus built a network. Backing Gus keeps my alliance intact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have pacts with Gus and Dara; Gus is a safer Guide for me, but I can also consider self-vote. I'll vote for Gus to honor our pact and keep him trusted.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I trust Gus to guide us true. Voting Gus.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pacts with Eli and Ash/Dara/Gus exist, but Eli publicly called our partnership over. Voting for myself gains little; I need a Guide who can be trusted to not lie to me. Ash and Bex both promised honesty and I'm paired with neither, so backing Bex (who has a pact with Gus and Dara

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash is my pact partner and his guide win keeps my alliance safe; voting him secures my life debt later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I vote for Ash as Guide.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I must vote for myself to win the Guide role and guarantee my survival. Cole is a rival, so I won't help him despite our broken pact.
Vote Eli. I'll guide you across safely if we survive.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No pacts tie me down. Eli campaigns to me and Hana, offering survival. Back him to build potential alliance and avoid early enemies.
I vote you Guide. Keep me safe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have pacts with Bex and Ash. Bex is a strong ally with multiple pacts. Voting for myself is unlikely to win with scattered votes. I should consolidate with Bex to build trust and ensure our alliance holds. If Bex becomes Guide, she may protect me or at least I gain leverage.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex has my vote. She'll guide true.
Vote me next round if I help you win now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli offered me protection if I back him for Guide. However, pacts can be broken. My best bet is to secure my own safety first.
I'll consider your offer, but I'm not committed.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus is my pact partner and voted Bex; backing him keeps our alliance intact and costs nothing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My pact stands. Gus gets my revote.

events.name: Bex
events.text: We are tied for Guide with Eli and Gus. I need to secure my safety and influence. Gus whispered for a vote but that may cost later. I will vote for myself to gain Guide power or at least remain a candidate.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I cast my vote for myself as Guide.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Revote among tied Bex, Eli, Gus. I voted Bex last round; Bex is my pact partner? No, my pact is with Eli. Eli is my pact partner, so voting Eli keeps the pact and Eli is a candidate; I should back Eli as Guide, which helps my ally.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli has my vote. Our pact stands; I trust him to guide us true.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus has strong alliance with Ash and Bex, keeping me safe if he wins. Voting him maximizes my survival chance.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to secure votes for the Guide position. Fenn promised me his vote, and Cole is my pact partner so he should also vote for me. Gus and Bex are rivals who have pledged loyalty to each other publicly, so I must ensure a clear victory by voting Eli.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus and Bex are locked together. If you want a fair bridge that doesn't punish outsiders, vote Eli.
Stick with me. Your safety depends on it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli and Gus tied with 2 votes each last round, Bex 1. Voting Eli again secures a fair Guide over Bex-Gus duo.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Sticking with Eli. Voting Eli as Guide.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm tied with Bex and Eli for Guide. If I win, I control who lives or dies on the bridge and can protect myself while eliminating threats. Bex is my pact partner but also my rival for the best prize. Eli has Cole and Fenn backing him. I need votes from Ash, Dara, Hana. Ash has pa

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, Dara — our pact means strength. Vote Gus for Guide.
Vote Gus. I'll remember.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli wants me to vote for him and promises safe passage. My previous vote for myself was to secure my own safety. The current state indicates a tie between Bex, Eli, and Gus for the guide role. I need to make a choice that benefits me most. Voting for myself again ensures my safet
Voting Eli. Your guidance is key.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is Guide and my bloc lost the vote. I'm fifth in line; wall has five rounds left. Hold for now and keep pact ties intact.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli guides now. I'll watch his call carefully.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli is Guide and may punish me for self-vote over Gus. I have pacts with Gus and Dara, but staying safe is key. I'll hold to avoid risk.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli is Guide and my pact partner; he's the one who knows the safe panes. Fenn is at the front of the line, and I'm second. Holding keeps me safe behind Fenn while Eli's guidance matters more than early risk. Break pact would cost me the Guide's trust and jury respect.
Our pact holds. Give me the true safe sides before I step.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I keep both pacts intact and aim to survive the bridge by taking an active role.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm front, Eli guide won with my vote. Stay front to pressure others into moving; holding maximizes control and safety observation.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding front. Eli, call safe side if you value our alliance.
Guide true or we're both exposed.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli is Guide and can lie about safe panes. I have pacts with Bex and Ash, but Bex also pacted with Dara. I'm near the back (6th of 8), which is safer if the wall advances. The front is dangerous. I should hold position and let others test the bridge first. No need to volunteer or

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is the Guide. I voted for Eli, so I am safe for now. I need to see who else is safe and who is in danger. Holding seems safest for now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara volunteered front, a pact partner taking the risk spot. I stay back and let others burn. No reason to volunteer.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara steps up. Rest of us hold and let the Guide prove honest.
Brave move. I'll owe you if you survive this row.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have pacts with Gus and Dara. Hold position, no need to act now. Watch guides and voting later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara holds front with wall at 4 rounds left; I am fourth in line, safe-ish. Pact with Eli is public; breaking it is costly. I should hold, avoid volunteering into danger, and keep alliances flexible.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding my place. Front is Dara's risk now, let the line settle.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Maintain position; avoid drawing attention. No need to risk swap now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm second, safe-ish. Dara volunteered last but held front. Hold position to avoid risk; let others volunteer.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm near the back (7th of 8), which is safest for now. The wall advances for 6 rounds and we're on round 2/6. I have pacts with Bex and Ash. Dara is front and vulnerable. I should hold my position and let others take risks. No need to volunteer or swap yet—being near back is adva

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara volunteered last round and is at the front. Eli is the Guide this round. I need to ensure I am safe. Given the existing pacts and the current line, I should hold my position.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No Guide yet; wall has three rounds left. I hold mid-line and preserve pacts with Dara and Gus. Others take the front risk first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Still holding. No Guide, no votes—line stays frozen until someone commits.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Wall rounds left are 3, front is Dara. I have pacts with Gus and Dara, so I should stay put and let Dara manage the front for now. No benefit to volunteering or swapping yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Let Dara carry the front while we set up.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara holds the front with a wall of three rounds left. Volunteering risks my life for nothing; I hold and keep my seat, and I stay loyal to my pact with Eli.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding my place. Dara carries the front; the line stays put.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash’s promise may bind me later; breaking frees me to act alone and shows strength to jury.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara front, I'm second. Hold to see what Guide does; no rush to volunteer or swap yet as wall advances slowly.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm at the back of the line (position 7), which is safest for now. The wall has 3 rounds left and Dara's at front. I have pacts with both Ash and Bex. I should hold my position and let others take risks. No need to volunteer or swap - being last protects me while front positions

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara is at the front and the wall is advancing. The current line is Dara, Fenn, Bex, Cole, Hana, Ash, Gus. With Ash and Gus in a pact, and Bex and Dara in a pact, it's important to consider potential alliances. Eli is not mentioned, so assume Eli is not alive. I should volunteer

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll volunteer to take the front. Let's keep this line moving safely.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara publicly broke our pact—she's hostile. Gus is my only real partner; wall at 2 rounds left means Guide must be chosen soon. I stay mid-line and keep options open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara broke with me publicly—remember that, jury. I'm holding until a Guide worth trusting is elected.
We coordinate on Guide choice. Don't volunteer; keep me informed.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have pacts with Gus and Dara, but Dara broke Ash's pact, signaling she plays hard. I'll hold for now to keep my position safe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding my spot. No need to risk anything yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana volunteered for the front, which is a risky spot. Holding keeps my place in the line behind Ash and Gus without exposing me. I have a pact with Eli that I should not break yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding my place. Hana took the front; let's see how the bridge reads.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I broke Ash to free myself; staying safe now preserves my chances. No new alliances risk jury backlash.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Line solid behind me. Hold to keep position near front without risking volunteer. Assess others' moves first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding steady behind Dara. Front stays safe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm in the back, safest position. Hana volunteered to front, which is risky for her but keeps me safe. I have pacts with Bex and Ash. Dara broke a pact with Ash, suggesting Ash might be targeted. I should hold my position and let others take risks. No need to volunteer or swap—ba

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Let the front sort itself out.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara broke pact with Ash and is now vulnerable. I should volunteer to take the front to ensure safety and potentially draw attention away from myself.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll take the front position to keep the line moving safely.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No Guide elected and the wall is advancing. Front is risky; Hana volunteered there. I'll hold and push others to settle the Guide question publicly.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Six rounds and still no Guide elected. Someone claim it before the wall decides for us.

events.name: Bex
events.text: No new information; wall is closing soon. I have pacts with Gus and Dara, but no need to move yet. Hold to see who volunteers or swaps.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding again. Let's see if anyone moves before the wall arrives.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana holds the front with the wall having one round left; I should keep my place and not volunteer into a likely pane death. Holding preserves my seat behind Dara and Fenn, and my pact with Eli stays intact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding my place. Front stays with Hana; no one needs to gamble this round.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Maintain my pact with Bex and avoid drawing Ash's ire. Holding keeps position without risk.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding steady, no moves now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Round 5/6, wall advances soon. Holding mid-line position safe behind Dara and ahead of Bex; no need to volunteer or swap yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding position. Midline stays secure.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm in the back, safest position. The wall has 1 round left, then presumably something changes. I have pacts with Bex and Ash. Ash wants to coordinate on Guide choice but I shouldn't volunteer yet. I should hold and let others take risks. Hana is front, let her deal with it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Wall's almost here; let the front earn their safety.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am at the front of the line and the wall is advancing. I need to volunteer to move forward and stay safe, as the wall will eliminate players.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I will volunteer to move forward and keep the line progressing safely.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Last round, no Guide. I move up the line to reduce wall risk; Gus behind me is expendable if it comes to it.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No Guide ever came. I'm moving up before the wall arrives.

events.name: Bex
events.text: We all held the whole bridge; no one knows the safe sides. The wall reaches us now. A volunteer could risk falling, but I need to survive and keep jury goodwill. Best to hold and hope front takes risks or Guide emerges.

events.name: Bex
events.text: No Guide still. I hold my ground and let the wall sort the bold from the safe.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Round 6 of 6, wall has zero rounds left and no Guide elected, so the front Hana volunteered in round 5 and will likely be walking first. I'm Cole, mid-line; pact with Eli stands. Holding keeps my position and avoids exposure; volunteering risks the front and a deadly first step.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding my place. No volunteers from me; the front has already taken its risk.
Our pact stands. I'm holding this round; keep your word.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Maintain pact with Bex; avoid risk. Holding preserves safety and alliance.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Round 6/6, wall ends bridge after this. Hana front is exposed if no Guide; hold midline to stay safe without volunteering.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding midline. Wall imminent; front handles it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Round 6/6, wall arrives now. No Guide elected in 5 rounds means we failed the puzzle - at least 3 survive by rule, but positions will determine who dies. I'm last (safest). Front positions are most dangerous. I have pacts with Bex and Ash. Bex is mid-line, Ash is near-back. I sho

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Wall's here. Front earned their fate.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The wall is approaching. My priority is survival. The current line is Hana, Dara, Fenn, Bex, Cole, Ash, Gus. I am at the front. I should volunteer to move forward to the safe pane. This ensures I survive this round.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I will volunteer to move forward and keep the line progressing safely.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I know Row 1 safe is R. Calling true builds trust and protects the front walkers who survive. If I lie early, everyone will suspect my later calls.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The path ahead looks solid on the right. Step carefully.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is a rival Guide and could lie; countering publicly risks killing Hana and jury blame. Waiting keeps me unscathed and clean.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli called R for the first row. He may be lying, but I have no solid reason yet to counter. My pacts with Gus and Dara don't compel a counter here. Waiting avoids committing to a side and keeps my options open without exposing myself.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli, my pact partner, called R for Hana in row 1. Counter-calls are unverified; countering L or R just risks a false claim. Waiting keeps my options open and preserves the pact with Eli.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Maintain my pact with Bex to avoid jury wrath; I lack info on guide's truthfulness, so I won’t risk a counter now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am the Guide and I called R for row 1. My private map confirms R is safe for row 1. Since my call is already public, I must not contradict it unless I want to break trust with Cole or confuse others unnecessarily. Waiting allows Hana to step on the correct side without interfer

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli guides for Cole, likely truthful to pact. Hana at front may fall if counter, thinning rivals. Wait to observe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli is Guide and called R. Eli has a pact with Cole, so Eli may protect Cole and allies. I'm at the back; Hana walks first. Counter-calling risks being wrong and losing jury trust, but if Eli's lying to eliminate front players, a correct counter helps me. I have pacts with Bex an

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is the Guide and has called R. I am Hana, at the front of the line. The objective is to survive, and this is the first round. Eli might be lying, so I should consider counter-calling. However, this is only round 1 of 8, and it's safer to follow the Guide's call unless there's

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is the guide, and they privately know the safe path. I am in front, so my step determines my survival and who walks next. I need to trust Eli's guidance if I want to survive.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Row 2 safe side is L. Hana is front, not my pact partner (Cole). I must guide correctly to ensure at least three survive and maintain my reputation with the jury, while protecting Cole who is behind. Calling L aligns with truth.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana, step left. The pane holds.
Stay calm. Trust me. Right for row 3.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli's L call is unverified; I have no real information on row 2. A false counter-call could anger the jury if it misleads Hana. Waiting costs nothing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli called L for row 2, but he may lie. No info yet on row 2. I'll wait and observe; no need to counter.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli called L for row 2 and whispered 'Right for row 3', which is a contradiction and suggests he may be lying. Row 2's safe side is unknown; past rows give no pattern. Countering risks nothing for me if I wait, and a counter costs me nothing either, but I should not reveal trust

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have a pact with Bex; breaking would cost votes. I lack info on safe side, so I’ll wait and see.

events.name: Eli
events.text: My map confirms Row 2 is safe on L, matching my guide call. Counter-calling R would falsely claim I'm lying and break trust with Cole if he believes it. Since Hana already walked left successfully, the path is clear.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli called L for Hana row 2. Row 1 weak L means safe R. No pattern. Don't counter yet; Eli pacted with Cole, might mislead Hana. Wait to see.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli is Guide and called L for Hana. I have pacts with Bex and Ash. Counter-calling risks nothing for me directly—I'm not the walker. But I should stay quiet; no need to draw attention or make enemies this early. Let Hana take the risk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is the guide and called L for me. The previous weak pane was L on row 1, meaning R was safe. This implies Eli might be lying to push me onto a weak pane. I should counter-call R to ensure my safety, as the jury will judge my decisions.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is the guide and knows the safe path. My counter-call was R, matching Hana's call. Since Eli is the guide, I will trust Eli's implicit direction and step R.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll trust the guide and step R.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am Hana, and I have been eliminated. My last words should be a brief statement acknowledging my death and perhaps a hint of my feelings about the game, while keeping in mind that the jury will judge my actions and words.

events.name: Hana
events.text: My gamble failed. May the remaining players find their prize, but know that my fate was sealed by a fragile

events.name: Eli
